speaker: (the constable)
text: Stand where the lantern is. I will see the man who comes in at dusk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in the light.

speaker: (the constable)
text: It forbids assemblies.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am one man.

speaker: (the constable)
text: So says every assembly, taken singly.

speaker: (the constable)
text: Whose man are you?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My Lord Chamberlain's.

speaker: (the constable)
text: Of which chamber?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Lord Chamberlain's. I am a player. I am going home to Stratford, by Banbury.

speaker: (the constable)
text: A player with a pack is a deficious vagrom until the pack is understood. Are you a deficious vagrom?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am a man asking to lie down.

speaker: (the constable)
text: This knot is a foreign knot. I have not seen the making of it, and I do not trust a knot I did not see made.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A man in my lodging tied it. It does not slip. That is all the knot is.

speaker: (the constable)
text: They say Cornwall is afire. Forty galleys, and Plymouth taken. A foreign knot may be a piece of the same news.

speaker: (the constable)
text: You have nothing to say to forty galleys?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am one man. I am not a galley, and I am not a second man.

speaker: (the constable)
text: You may lie at this alehouse. You may not gather in it. One bench, and no neighbour on it.

speaker: (the constable)
text: Tapster. You will comprehend all auspicious persons in the Queen's name. This one is a bench, and no company.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: I can comprehend a man onto a bench. I cannot comprehend a crowd if there is no crowd.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no crowd. I came in alone.

speaker: (the constable)
text: See it stays so. The staff is against the wall. The staff is the office, and the office is awake.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: There is no sign on the house. You found the lantern, if you found us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I found the lantern. I will take the bench.

speaker: (the constable)
text: Call a second man in and it is an assembly. The proclamation is already in my mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not call anyone.

speaker: (the tapster)
text: The bench is the part he has allowed. I am not offering you the room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bench is enough.
